baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3-4, 6, 10, and 15 link signs, Book, descent, truth, and non-belief.
baseline_models.mechanism: Marked units are joined as writing; their agreement with fixed reality makes a claim true, and belief is assent in which the heart can settle. The Book is an evidentiary composition rather than an opaque title.

activation_trace.role: Visible marking makes each ayah an inspectable indicator.
Joining separate pieces makes the Book a coordinated whole.
Ordered letters give that joined whole its written form.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the criterion of truth.
Heart-resting assent names the intended reception of the evidence.

changed_reading.before: These are verses of the Book, and the delivered message is true.
changed_reading.after: These marked units form a mutually supporting written whole whose correspondence with reality solicits settled assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence Book, sent down from your Lord, truth, and non-belief at words 4-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sovereign source delivers an established determination; truth is not only accuracy but a due that has become binding, while belief supplies the corresponding relation of trust and entrusted response.

activation_trace.role: A written determination supplies the binding register or judgment.
Caused delivery makes the determination arrive from its source to its addressee.
Ownership and governing authority ground the determination's claim.
A fixed due turns truth from description into an obligation with standing.
Security, trust, and entrusted fidelity supply the fitting human response.

changed_reading.before: The revelation accurately states facts even though most reject it.
changed_reading.after: The delivered truth also bears a binding claim from its governing source, so non-belief is a failure of entrusted response as well as assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive descent from the Lord at words 6-9 and the predication of truth at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent can be placement at an apt station, while both mapped branches of the source root contribute completion and growth. Truth then appears as a communication fitted and reinforced for developmental reception, not merely transported downward.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper rank turns descent into calibrated placement.
Repair, nurture, and completion give the source relation a staged pedagogical function.
The alternate mapped growth branch keeps developmental nourishment live rather than collapsing the split root.
Tight, corrected construction makes truth the robustness of the placed communication.
A part fitting its proper joint supplies the image of exact contextual fit.

changed_reading.before: A true message moved vertically from the Lord to the recipient.
changed_reading.after: A nurturing source placed a robust communication at the fitting human level so that reception could mature.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Visible signs at word 3 stand against most people not believing at words 12-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse juxtaposes marked visibility with a human collective whose root inventory includes perceiving and becoming familiar, yet numerical predominance does not become inward security. The failure is paradoxically perceptual, social, and fiduciary at once.

activation_trace.role: An outward mark supplies evidence available to perception.
Predominance by number makes the majority socially weighty without making it evidentially right.
Visible humanity supplies the collective that stands before the visible marks.
Seeing, hearing, and sensing sharpen the irony of evidence that is encountered but not received.
Inward security and trust mark what perception and social familiarity fail to produce.

changed_reading.before: A large demographic group does not accept the message.
changed_reading.after: The perceptive human majority can stand among visible indicators yet remain inwardly unentrusted and unsettled by them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns the opening sign-system outward: elevated structures and timed motions are governed with their outcomes in view, then articulated as distinct signs whose intended endpoint is certainty.

activation_trace.role: Physical elevation supplies the large-scale structure that becomes readable evidence.
Planning by consequences makes the displayed system governed rather than accidental.
Articulating parts and meanings turns the signs into an explanatory sequence.
Knowledge fixed after doubt supplies the reception toward which exposition is directed.

structural_cues: 13:2 moves from raised heavens without visible supports through regulated trajectories and deadlines to detailed signs, encounter with the Lord, and certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevation, governed trajectories, articulated signs, and certainty; I infer that the opening Book trains perception of a managed world. A live alternative is that creation is separate corroboration rather than an extension of the Book's sign-system.

changed_reading.before: The Book contains verbal indicators that state a true message.
changed_reading.after: The Book's indicators disclose the same ordered governance visible in the world and train the reader from observed structure toward certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separated but neighboring plots share one input and yield unequal outcomes. This makes an ayah function as a controlled comparison: hold source and proximity steady, inspect difference, then bind the observations into reasoned judgment.

activation_trace.role: Distinct pieces establish comparable units without erasing their separation.
Physical adjacency controls distance while preserving difference between the units.
Union in one respect supplies the common input against which outcomes can be compared.
Surplus and differential outcome make variation itself evidentiary.
A reason that restrains error binds the separated observations into a warranted inference.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 repeat signs after paired forms, adjacent plots, one water, unequal produce, and a closing appeal to reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pieces, adjacency, common input, unequal yield, and reason; I supply the controlled-comparison arrow. The alternative is a catalog of wonders with no experimental relation among them.

changed_reading.before: The signs are individual wonders collected in a Book.
changed_reading.after: The signs also teach a comparative method in which controlled sameness and neighboring difference jointly reveal ordered causation.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the opening presents plural signs joined in a Book, denial of renewed creation is followed by a demand that one sign be sent down. Disbelief can therefore work by covering an available system while continually narrowing admissible evidence to a newly demanded token.

activation_trace.role: Reaction to the unfamiliar exposes surprise as the pressure point in the denial of renewed creation.
Covering the truth makes rejection an active screening operation rather than simple absence of data.
Demanded delivery repeats the opening's descent relation but turns it into a condition imposed by the hearer.
A visible mark is requested in the singular despite the already asserted plurality of indicators.
Warning aims to awaken caution rather than satisfy an escalating spectacle test.
Gentle direction supplies a non-coercive mode of guidance for each community.

structural_cues: 13:5 labels the resurrection claim surprising; 13:7 repeats descent-sign-Lord as a demand for one sign after 13:1 has already asserted signs and Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, repeated opening vocabulary, and a singular demand; I infer a moving admission threshold. The demand could instead be sincere but aimed at a different class of sign.

changed_reading.before: Most people fail to believe because the revelation does not persuade them.
changed_reading.after: Non-belief may manufacture evidentiary scarcity by covering an integrated sign-system and demanding an isolated token on its own terms.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true call is set against invocations that receive no answer and against hands extended toward water that never reaches the mouth. Truth acquires a relational test: a sound address connects source, recipient, answer, and attainable end.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the initiating address whose effectiveness is being contrasted.
Stable truth qualifies the call that genuinely corresponds to its addressee and end.
A returned answer supplies the missing link in the futile invocations.
Extending the hand provides effort and direction without guaranteeing contact.
An outstretched asking hand makes failed reception bodily visible.
Arrival at the intended endpoint supplies the criterion the water image fails.
Missing the intended path names the failed address-response circuit.

structural_cues: 13:14 contrasts a true call with non-response, then repeats reaching in a hand-water-mouth image whose goal is explicitly not attained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, answer, extension, and failed arrival; I infer that efficacy belongs to the focus truth's communicative force. The alternative is that the image evaluates worship alone without revising the opening's truth predicate.

changed_reading.before: Truth is a property predicated of the content sent down.
changed_reading.after: Truth also names a viable address-response relation in which the delivered word can reach, orient, and be answered, unlike a call with no attainable respondent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent initiates capacity-bounded flows that carry swelling surface froth; the froth departs while useful matter remains. The opening's truth is no longer only a proposition at arrival: it is what survives reception, turbulence, and separation as durable benefit.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the initiating input and directly recalls the focus descent.
A measure that bounds each thing makes channel capacity control the resulting flow.
Visible carrying moves the byproduct with the flood rather than making it the flood's substance.
Floating froth supplies a prominent but superficial surplus produced by agitation.
Swelling height explains how false surplus can look dominant at the surface.
Fixed correspondence identifies the stable side of the explicit contrast.
Loss of truth and stability names what cannot survive the separating process.
Concrete benefit supplies a functional test beyond visual prominence.
Remaining with duration makes persistence the temporal test of the useful remainder.

structural_cues: 13:17 orders descent, channels by capacity, carried froth, a truth-falsehood comparison, disappearance of froth, and the remaining benefit to people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the full material sequence and explicitly names truth and falsehood; I infer that it reprocesses the opening's descended truth through reception over time. The live alternative is a general parable whose truth need not be identified specifically with the Book.

changed_reading.before: What arrives from the Lord is propositionally true at the moment of delivery.
changed_reading.after: Descended truth proves itself through capacity-sensitive reception: noisy surplus separates away, while a stable and beneficial remainder endures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus descent-Lord-truth proposition is repeated almost verbatim, then its receiver is contrasted with inner blindness and characterized by recollection. Belief becomes recovered perception and knowledge, not bare subscription to a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower turns reception of the proposition into cognition.
Repeated delivery pins the cognitive contrast directly to the focus revelation.
Nurturing completion keeps knowledge relational to the source rather than merely informational.
Reality-correspondence is the object disclosed to the knower.
Blindness of inward perception supplies the contrary mode of reception.
Recovering what was held but not present makes understanding an act of recollection.

structural_cues: 13:19 repeats the opening clause, contrasts knower with blind, and ends with branchless ل ب ب at word 15; that uncitable root is used only as the structural cue of an inner core.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact verbal recurrence, knowledge, blindness, recollection, and an inner-core cue; I infer a reception model of recognition. The alternative is that these are consequences of prior belief rather than an unpacking of it.

changed_reading.before: Belief means accepting the true status of what was sent down.
changed_reading.after: Belief involves recognizing the descended truth with inward sight and recollective understanding; denial is a mode of blindness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who know the truth complete a preserved compact, refuse to unbind it, and connect what is ordered; the opposite group unbinds, cuts connection, and drives things out of sound order. The Book's binding judgment becomes a maintained relational network.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies faithful performance of the compact.
A preserved compact trusted by its holder gives the obligation relational form.
Unbinding what was made firm defines the prohibited reversal.
A confirmed covenant supplies the firmness that unbinding would destroy.
Unbroken succession makes fidelity an ongoing connection rather than a momentary assent.
Severing a bond supplies the social and structural opposite of faithful reception.
Departure from sound order names the system-level result of broken connection.

structural_cues: 13:20-25 mirror completing, preserving, and connecting against unbinding, cutting, and corrupting, with opposed outcomes.
The branchless root د ر ء at 13:22 word 13 marks reversal of harm with good and is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored connection vocabulary and enacted practices; I infer that these operationalize the focus branches of binding Book, due truth, and entrusted belief. They may instead be downstream ethics rather than semantic expansion.

changed_reading.before: The Book imposes a true claim that a believer accepts.
changed_reading.after: Accepting the Book means maintaining a covenantal network through completion and connection; disbelief materializes as unbinding, severance, and systemic disorder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The security branch latent in belief becomes explicit as repeated settling of hearts through repeated remembrance, then belief is coupled with intentional work and repair. Trust is a stabilized inner process with outward consequences.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust provide the latent state that the following heart sequence makes explicit.
Repeated stilling and reassurance realize belief as an achieved inner stability.
The heart supplies the locus in which trust becomes settled rather than merely spoken.
Repeated recollection supplies the process that restores and maintains stability.
Intentional action carries settled trust into purposeful conduct.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives that conduct its reparative direction.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats heart-settling-remembrance in a reversed formulation, and 13:29 immediately couples belief with work that is sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, doubled tranquility, doubled heart and remembrance, then work and repair; I infer a maintenance loop from remembrance to settled trust to action. Tranquility may instead be only a consequence of belief.

changed_reading.before: To believe is to assent to the truth of the delivered content.
changed_reading.after: To believe is also to enter a recurrent process in which remembrance settles the heart into trust and trust issues in reparative action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A recited, collected discourse is placed in a counterfactual series of moving mountains, cutting earth, and making the dead speak, yet universal human guidance remains assigned to divine willing. The Book guides without functioning as a machine that compels belief by spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Recitation names the discourse whose imagined physical effects are being tested.
Caused movement supplies the first spectacular transformation.
A high solid mass makes that movement maximally resistant and visible.
Physical severing supplies the second coercively visible transformation.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the third impossible communication.
Loss of life makes speech the strongest boundary-crossing sign in the series.
Assent remains present after the spectacle series rather than being mechanically produced by it.
Gentle direction offers a mode of guidance distinct from physical compulsion.
The whole visible human collective is the stated horizon of the unrealized universal guidance.

structural_cues: 13:31 orders three counterfactual transformations, returns all command to God, then places belief, willing, guidance, and all people in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the counterfactual spectacle and the unforced guidance clause; I infer a distinction between revelatory address and mechanical compulsion. A live alternative is that the counterfactual magnifies this discourse's power rather than limiting spectacle as a mode of proof.

changed_reading.before: The signs fail to make most people believe despite their evidentiary force.
changed_reading.after: The Book's mode is communicative guidance, not a physical mechanism that overrides the recipient and converts the whole human collective by spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Book moves through written reception, partial denial, articulated judgment, a register for each term, erasure and confirmation, and a source register. The opening definite Book can therefore activate as layered administration: communicative inscription, binding allocation, and authoritative source need not be the same level.

activation_trace.role: Written form supplies the received textual layer over which audiences divide.
Failure to recognize or acknowledge supplies one reception mode.
Partition makes denial selective rather than an all-or-nothing response.
Judgment gives the descended discourse an executable normative layer.
Clear articulation makes that judgment linguistically addressable rather than abstract.
A delimited term supplies the temporal key by which a register is allocated.
A fixed determination makes each temporal register operative rather than merely documentary.
Removal of an inscription's trace supplies controlled mutability within the register system.
Proof and confirmation supply the complementary act that authorizes what remains.
An origin, collector, and reference point supplies a source layer for derivative registers.
The source Book holds authoritative determination even while lower traces can be erased or confirmed.

structural_cues: 13:36-39 sequence received Book, selective denial, descended articulated judgment, a Book for every term, erasure, confirmation, and the mother or source of the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and all register operations; I supply a layered relation between the opening definite Book, term-specific books, and source Book. The alternative is that these uses remain distinct without revising the opening referent.

changed_reading.before: The Book is a stable codex containing the true revelation.
changed_reading.after: The Book is also a layered temporal register: articulated text and binding allocations can be administered through erasure and confirmation under an authoritative source register.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing denial of messengership is answered by sufficient witness and by one who has knowledge of the Book. The opening Book is thus not self-enclosed text: its truth enters an evidentiary relation of knowing testimony.

activation_trace.role: Standing for the matter until it suffices supplies the adequacy of the answer to denial.
Testimony grounded in knowledge makes truth publicly evidentiary.
A sign that bears witness links the closing testimony back to the opening indicators.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the human side of the witness relation.
The written Book supplies the knowable object through which testimony is qualified.

structural_cues: 13:43 begins with denial of the messenger and closes the surah with sufficiency, witness, relational betweenness, knowledge, and Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial and two forms of knowledgeable witness; I infer that the Book participates in a testimonial ecology. The alternative is that only its knower testifies, so the Book itself should not be personified as a witness.

changed_reading.before: The Book asserts its own truth despite majority rejection.
changed_reading.after: The Book's truth is knowable and witness-bearing within relations of testimony that answer rejection without making the text a self-sufficient object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The social majority is never explicitly equated with foam, so the cross-domain mapping is surprising; it remains anchored in the focus words for most, people, truth, and belief and in 13:17's rising froth versus enduring human benefit. Render only as an analogy that strips number of truth-weight, not as an identification of people with waste.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The majority claim at words 12-15 beside truth at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Numerical abundance supplies the focus quantity whose epistemic weight is being questioned.
Winning by numbers supplies the social pressure that can masquerade as evidentiary force.
Floating froth gives abundance a visually dominant but superficial material analogue.
Swelling upward explains how surface quantity can temporarily command attention.
Benefit supplies a criterion independent of bulk.
Persistence supplies a criterion independent of temporary predominance.

changed_reading.before: Most people names only the scale of non-belief.
changed_reading.after: The later foam process makes numerical predominance itself suspect: a swelling majority can dominate the surface without carrying the durable weight of truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the signs through the remote waiting branch is form-distant from the ordinary noun and therefore surprising; it remains anchored by the supplied focus branch, descent's station branch, and later duration cues. Render as a temporal reading practice invited by the root inventory, never as the lexical definition of ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Signs at word 3 and descent at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Lingering and waiting turn a sign from an instant token into a place of sustained attention.
A station or lodging gives descent a place where the reader can remain.
A fixed temporal limit places the displayed motions inside duration.
Remaining with patience makes truth's persistence visible only after turbulence passes.
Each delimited term reinforces signs and registers as temporally staged rather than instantaneous.

changed_reading.before: A sign should deliver immediate proof on inspection.
changed_reading.after: A sign can be a station at which perception must linger until transient surplus passes and the truth's durable remainder appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The packet never calls shadows written characters, so treating them as script is a deliberately cross-domain activation; it remains anchored in visible signs, written Book, bodily bending, cast shadows, and the two edges of day. Render only as a metaphor for involuntary embodied testimony alongside conscious non-belief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Visible signs and written Book at words 3-4 against human non-belief at words 12-15.

activation_trace.role: Visible marking permits natural forms to be read as indicators.
Inscribed ordering supplies the metaphorical script into which moving marks are composed.
Bending down gives the script a bodily grammar of submission.
A shadow cast by an upright body supplies the moving visible stroke.
The beginning of day sets one temporal edge of the moving inscription.
Late day sets the other temporal edge across which the shadow changes.

changed_reading.before: The Book's signs are textual claims that many humans consciously reject.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory level, daily shadows form a moving script of embodied submission even where conscious human trust remains absent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The semiotic contrast between the opening signs and the command to name partners is inferred rather than stated, which makes it surprising; it remains anchored in signs, truth, naming, reporting, knowledge, outward speech, and adornment. Render as a contrast between grounded and ungrounded signs, not as a claim that every false name is grammatically equivalent to disbelief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Marked signs at word 3 and reality-corresponding truth at word 10.

activation_trace.role: A visible indicator supplies the focus model of a sign grounded in what it marks.
Correspondence with stable reality supplies the test for grounded signification.
Naming as designation supplies labels whose referents are being challenged.
A reported item should bring information rather than merely circulate a label.
Disclosure to knowledge supplies the missing warrant for the named partners.
Outward appearance supplies the merely surface level at which unsupported speech can operate.
A thing's own indication contrasts meaningful signification with imposed verbal naming.
Applied beautification explains how an unsupported construction can become persuasive in appearance.

changed_reading.before: The opening signs state truth while disbelievers reject it.
changed_reading.after: The opening signs can also be read as grounded names whose referents withstand knowledge, unlike adorned surface speech that assigns names without disclosed reality.

strongest_changes: The opening signs became an ordered comparative apparatus that reads differentiated systems rather than a list of wonders.
Truth became the durable, beneficial remainder that survives capacity-bound flow and material separation.
Belief became settled entrusted response, then covenantal connection and reparative action, rather than bare assent.
The Book became simultaneously composed writing, binding judgment, timed register, and witnessed knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated opening vocabulary did opposite work: 13:7 exposed a demand that screens out an already-given sign-system, while 13:19 turned the same descent-Lord-truth proposition into knowledge versus blindness. The material foam process and the erase-confirm register preserved distinct readings that a single doctrinal paraphrase would collapse. Branchless ل ب ب and د ر ء were used only as structural cues.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from 13:17's general truth-falsehood parable specifically back to the descended Book is abductive, though repeated descent and truth roots make it strong.
The register model depends on relating the definite Book of 13:1 to term-specific books and the source Book of 13:38-39; the uses may remain distinct layers without revising one referent.
The waiting-sign, numerical-foam, shadow-script, and name-referent readings are exploratory analogies and should not be rendered as lexical definitions.
